thread:
alice_support: FYI — customer hitting mid-stream SSE disconnects during mobile network switch. Request-id r-9f4b2c3a, model=redwood-large-v1, iOS 16.6, observed when switching 5G -> home WiFi. They see partial output then stream stops. Attaching minimal logs below.

ingrid_mobile: Repro steps I used:
1) Start a streaming chat from app (EventSource via our SDK).
2) After ~8-15s of tokens, toggle airplane mode off/on or force a carrier->wifi handoff.
3) Client receives a few partial chunks then EventSource triggers `onerror` and closes.

Logs (client side):
```
[10:12:03.432] SSE open, headers ok
[10:12:11.121] partial chunk: "Hello there, I can"
[10:12:12.987] network change: carrier->wifi
[10:12:13.004] EventSource error, readyState=2
[10:12:13.006] close() called by SDK
```

ben_engineer: Can you confirm the SDK is using native EventSource or our polyfill? Native EventSource on iOS WebView has known quirks with socket handoffs. Also, do we surface `Last-Event-ID` or a resume token?

ingrid_mobile: Using our JS SDK (polyfill) + RN WebView. We currently do not include a resume token in the stream payload — it starts new session when reconnecting.

maya_sre: From server logs for r-9f4b2c3a: connection terminated with code 499 (client closed) right after TLS rekey. Server sent keepalive at t-10s and next at t-40s, so there was a ~30s gap where client-level TCP retransmits likely timed out.

maya_sre: Quick notes:
- We emit SSE comment `:keepalive\n\n` every 30s by default.
- Mobile carriers can drop idle sockets faster during a handoff.
- When client switches networks, native stacks may abort sockets instead of transparently migrating.

ben_engineer: Two-pronged approach:
- Client: reduce keepalive interval to 8-10s, surface a resume token in the first chunk metadata, and do exponential reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` or a custom `x-resume-token` header. Example client snippet:
```
const es = new EventSource(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
es.onmessage = (e) => { /* parse JSON, capture resume_token from meta */ };
// onerror -> attempt reconnect after 500ms, include resume_token if present
```

ben_engineer: Server-side mitigations we can try quickly: lower keepalive to 15s for mobile pool, reduce idle socket close to 45s, and log `x-resume-token` to correlate partial outputs.

ingrid_mobile: I can push a client-side change for an internal build to test keepalive at 10s and reconnect with last-event-id. Would like a short server-side tweak to reduce keepalive to 15s while we test.

maya_sre: Filed infra task and assigned to eng-sre: ENG-1129. Will try a config tweak on canary pool (reduce SSE comment interval to 15s and idle close to 45s).

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: canary=redwood-mobile-pool-3, change="sse_keepalive_interval=15s,idle_timeout=45s", window=10m.

alice_support: I'll ask customer to install the test build and confirm. If they still see abrupt closes, we'll capture a full packet trace and have them enable SDK debug logging.

ben_engineer: Longer-term: implement resumable streams via `resume_token` in chunk metadata so clients can reconnect and continue from last token without re-generating. Also update docs for RN/WebView-specific guidance.

ingrid_mobile: Quick repro plan for customer: enable SDK debug, test internal build v1.2.7-rc2 (keepalive=10s) and report whether stream now completes across handoff.

alice_support: Customer agreed to try RC today. Marking thread for follow-up. :thumbsup:
